Explaining an Absence in German: A2 Phrase Practice

Tell a class or group that you cannot attend and ask about catching up in German. Practise fehlen and nachholen with translations and explained A2 answers.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

A short absence message can identify the affected session and state that you cannot attend: Ich kann am Donnerstag nicht teilnehmen. Fehlen means being absent in this context. Den Stoff nachholen means catching up on material missed, while Bescheid geben means letting someone know.

Common mistake to avoid

Nachholen refers to catching up on the missed work here, not automatically changing the class date. Fehlen can also mean being missing in other contexts.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich kann am Donnerstag leider nicht am Unterricht teilnehmen.Unfortunately I cannot attend class on Thursday.
Worked example 2Am nächsten Kurstag werde ich noch fehlen.I will still be absent on the next course day.
Worked example 3Den verpassten Stoff möchte ich am Wochenende nachholen.I would like to catch up on the missed material at the weekend.
Worked example 4Ich gebe Ihnen wegen meiner Abwesenheit frühzeitig Bescheid.I am letting you know about my absence early.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the absence or catch-up phrase with the verb or notification noun specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Bescheid · fehlen · nachholen · teilnehmen

Question 1. Morgen werde ich leider ___. (be absent)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: fehlen

Fehlen has the attendance-related meaning here.

Question 2. Ich kann diesmal nicht an der Sitzung ___. (take part)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: teilnehmen

An einer Sitzung teilnehmen means taking part in it.

Question 3. Die verpasste Übung möchte ich ___. (catch up on)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: nachholen

Nachholen concerns completing missed work.

Question 4. Ich gebe der Lehrerin heute noch ___. (notice, in the notification phrase)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Bescheid

Bescheid geben means letting someone know.
